mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases the probability of negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 2-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening household demand, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, monetary policy is sufficiently restrictive to depress credit growth and capex, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) above 0.5% per month signals robust labor market expansion, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% per month for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated PAYEMS growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening economic activity, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining INDPRO and RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening household demand, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) below 2% combined with a 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals easing monetary policy and falling inflation risk premium, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of declining CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).
